<li><strong>SuperGrok:</strong> Standard business access with enhanced quotas and features.</li>
<li><strong>SuperGrok Heavy:</strong> Upgraded performance for demanding workloads.</li>
</ul><p>To purchase:</p><ol>
<li>On the overview page, select the license type and quantity.</li>
<li>Enter payment details if prompted <em>(requires billing read-write permissions)</em>.</li>
<li>Confirm the purchase—licenses will be added to your available pool for assignment.</li>
</ol><p>Purchased licenses become immediately available for provisioning to users.</p><span class="not-prose"><div class="[&amp;_a]:decoration-current/50 bg-card my-5 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 font-sans text-xs leading-5 [&amp;_a]:text-inherit [&amp;_a]:underline text-primary/80 flex flex-row items-start gap-2"><div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-0 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0 self-start"><div class="flex-shrink-0"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" data-slot="icon" class="stroke-[2] size-3.5 text-[#999] dark:text-[#555]"><g id="name=info-circle"><g id="vector"><path d="M12 11.0996C12.4971 11.0996 12.9004 11.5029 12.9004 12V16.5H11.0996V12.9004H10.5V11.0996H12Z" fill="currentColor"></path><path d="M12 7.40039C12.6626 7.40039 13.2 7.93706 13.2002 8.59961C13.2002 9.26235 12.6627 9.7998 12 9.7998C11.3373 9.79978 10.7998 9.26233 10.7998 8.59961C10.8 7.93707 11.3374 7.40042 12 7.40039Z" fill="currentColor"></path><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M12 2C17.5228 2 22 6.47715 22 12C22 17.5228 17.5228 22 12 22C6.47715 22 2 17.5228 2 12C2 6.47715 6.47715 2 12 2ZM12 4C7.58172 4 4 7.58172 4 12C4 16.4183 7.58172 20 12 20C16.4183 20 20 16.4183 20 12C20 7.58172 16.4183 4 12 4Z" fill="currentColor"></path></g></g></svg></div></div><div class="min-w-0 flex-1 [&amp;&gt;p:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;&gt;p:last-child]:mb-0 [&amp;_code]:font-mono [&amp;_strong]:rounded [&amp;_strong]:font-semibold"><p><strong>Billing Note:</strong> Ensure your team&#x27;s billing is set up correctly to avoid
interruptions. <li>On the overview page, click &quot;Invite users to Grok Business&quot;.</li>
<li>Enter the users&#x27; email addresses.</li>
<li>Select a license type to auto-provision upon acceptance <em>(requires team read-write permissions)</em>.</li>
<li>Send the invitation—the user will receive an email with a link to activate their account.</li>
</ol><p>Invited users gain access to the team workspace and basic team read permissions. (the latter is to allow for sharing conversations with your team members)</p><p>View invited users in the &quot;Pending invitations&quot; list on the overview page. As long as you have unassigned licenses available, they will be automatically provisioned when the user accepts.</p><figure class="flex max-h-[540px] w-full items-center justify-center"><img data-original-src="/assets/docs/grok-business/invite-users.png" data-original-width="1130" data-original-height="1010" alt="Inviting users and viewing the invited users list" loading="lazy" width="604" height="540" decoding="async" data-nimg="1" class="border object-contain object-center rounded-md" style="color:transparent;background-size:cover;background-position:50% 50%;background-repeat:no-repeat;background-image:url(&quot;data:image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8,%3Csvg xmlns=&#x27;http://www.w3.org/2000/svg&#x27; height=&#x27;100%25&#x27; x=&#x27;0&#x27; y=&#x27;0&#x27; preserveAspectRatio=&#x27;none&#x27; style=&#x27;filter: url(%23b);&#x27; href=&#x27;data:image/png;base64,&#x27;/%3E%3C/svg%3E&quot;)" srcSet="/_next/image?url=%2Fassets%2Fdocs%2Fgrok-business%2Finvite-users.png&amp;w=640&amp;q=75&amp;dpl=b1d4248aa2d76f78be8d304a69265e186e77dc09 1x, /_next/image?url=%2Fassets%2Fdocs%2Fgrok-business%2Finvite-users.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=75&amp;dpl=b1d4248aa2d76f78be8d304a69265e186e77dc09 2x" src="/_next/image?url=%2Fassets%2Fdocs%2Fgrok-business%2Finvite-users.png&amp;w=1920&amp;q=75&amp;dpl=b1d4248aa2d76f78be8d304a69265e186e77dc09"/></figure><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="assigning-and-revoking-licenses" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#assigning-and-revoking-licenses">Assigning and Revoking Licenses</a></h2></span><p>Once licenses are purchased or available, assign them to users for full team workspace access.</p><p>To assign:</p><ol>
<li>From the overview page, select a user from your team list.</li>
<li>Choose an available license and assign it—access activates immediately.</li>
</ol><p>To revoke:</p><ol>
<li>Click the &quot;...&quot; for the user and choose &quot;Unassign License&quot; from the dropdown.</li>
<li>Confirm the action—the license returns to your available pool, and the user will no longer have access to your team&#x27;s workspace.</li>
</ol><p>Revocations take effect instantly, so ensure that you communicate changes to affected users.</p><span class="not-prose"><div class="bg-card my-5 rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 font-sans text-xs leading-5 [&amp;_a]:text-inherit [&amp;_a]:underline text-[hsl(353,20%,35%)] dark:text-[hsl(353,20%,70%)] [&amp;_a]:decoration-[hsl(353,25%,55%)] dark:[&amp;_a]:decoration-[hsl(353,20%,38%)] flex flex-row items-start gap-2"><div class="flex items-center gap-2 ml-0 mt-0.5 flex-shrink-0 self-start"><div class="flex-shrink-0"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" data-slot="icon" class="stroke-[2] size-3.5 dark:text-[#555] text-fg-danger"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="9" stroke="currentColor"></circle><circle cx="12" cy="15.4" r="1.2" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"></circle><path fill-rule="evenodd" clip-rule="evenodd" d="M12.395 7.5C12.9866 7.5 13.4489 8.01082 13.39 8.5995L13 12.5H11L10.61 8.5995C10.5511 8.01082 11.0134 7.5 11.605 7.5H12.395Z" fill="currentColor" stroke="none"></path></svg></div></div><div class="min-w-0 flex-1 [&amp;&gt;p:first-child]:mt-0 [&amp;&gt;p:last-child]:mb-0 [&amp;_code]:font-mono [&amp;_strong]:rounded [&amp;_strong]:font-semibold"><p><strong>Impact Warning:</strong> Revoking a license removes team workspace access. Users will
retain personal workspace functionality.</p></div></div></span><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="canceling-licenses" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#canceling-licenses">Canceling Licenses</a></h2></span><p>Reduce your team&#x27;s commitment by canceling unused licenses.</p><p>To cancel:</p><ol>
<li>On the overview page, select the license type and quantity to cancel.</li>
<li>Submit the cancellation request <em>(requires billing read-write permissions)</em>.</li>
</ol><p>Cancellations may take a few days to process, and eligible refunds will be issued to your billing method. Canceled licenses are removed from your pool once processed.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="sharing-policy" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#sharing-policy">Sharing policy</a></h2></span><p>Team admins decide how widely members can share Grok Business resources. A sharing policy sets the <em>widest</em> audience a member may pick for a given resource; members can always share more narrowly, never more broadly.</p><p>Configure these policies in <a href="https://console.x.ai?utm_source=docs&amp;utm_medium=referral&amp;utm_campaign=grok-management&amp;utm_content=console-home" target="_blank" rel="noopener" class="text-primary underline has-[code]:decoration-solar has-[code]:decoration-dotted has-[code]:underline-offset-2">console.x.ai</a> under your team&#x27;s <strong>Sharing &amp; Retention</strong> settings, in the <strong>Product Sharing</strong> section. Each resource type carries its own policy: conversations, projects, and skills.</p><p>The levels form a ladder from most to least restrictive:</p><div class="not-prose my-6 w-full overflow-x-auto"><table class="w-full border-collapse text-left text-sm [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-border [&amp;_thead_tr]:border-b [&amp;_th]:text-secondary [&amp;_th]:px-3 [&amp;_th]:py-2.5 [&amp;_th]:text-left [&amp;_th]:align-bottom [&amp;_th]:text-sm [&amp;_th]:font-light [&amp;_tbody]:divide-border [&amp;_tbody]:divide-y [&amp;_td]:px-3 [&amp;_td]:py-4 [&amp;_td]:align-top [&amp;_td:first-child]:text-primary [&amp;_td:first-child]:font-medium [&amp;_td:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_th:first-child]:!pl-0 [&amp;_td_li]:before:text-subtle [&amp;_td_li]:before:mr-1.5 [&amp;_td_li]:before:content-[&quot;•&quot;] [&amp;_td_ul]:m-0 [&amp;_td_ul]:list-none [&amp;_td_ul]:space-y-1.5 [&amp;_td_ul]:p-0 [&amp;_tbody_tr:last-child_td]:border-b-0"><thead><tr><th>Level</th><th>What members can do</th></tr></thead><tbody><tr><td>Private</td><td>Sharing is turned off for that resource.</td></tr><tr><td>Team</td><td>Share with individual teammates and with the member&#x27;s own team. Organization-wide and cross-team sharing are blocked.</td></tr><tr><td>Organization</td><td>Everything Team allows, plus sharing across teams and with everyone in the organization.</td></tr><tr><td>Public</td><td>Everything Organization allows, plus public links that anyone can open, including people outside the team.</td></tr></tbody></table></div><p>Public links apply to conversations only; projects and skills cap at Organization. By default, conversations and projects can be shared organization-wide, and skills start at Private.</p><p>Tightening a policy applies right away. Members can no longer create shares wider than the new ceiling, and access to existing shares beyond it is restricted to match.</p><hr/><span class="not-prose"><h2 id="permissions-and-troubleshooting" class="scroll-mt-28 font-medium transition-colors duration-100 ease-in-out lg:scroll-mt-24 text-primary mb-4 mt-12 text-xl leading-snug"><a class="not-prose" href="#permissions-and-troubleshooting">Permissions and Troubleshooting</a></h2></span><p>Most management actions require specific role-based permissions:</p><ul>
<li><strong>Billing Read-Write:</strong> Needed to purchase or cancel licenses.</li>
<li><strong>Team Read-Write:</strong> Needed to invite users or assign/revoke licenses.</li>
</ul><p>These are typically granted only to team admins. If you lack permissions:</p><ul>
<li>Contact your team admin to request actions like license assignment or purchases.</li>
<li>Admins can adjust permissions via the overview page&#x27;s role settings.</li>
</ul><p>If you encounter issues, such as invitations not provisioning due to insufficient licenses, purchase more or revoke unused ones first.</p><span class="not-prose"><div
